name: malakim_adept
description: a Malakim Adept (Fall from Heaven), a desert mage: brown skin and a short black beard, a cream turban with a gold-set teal jewel at the front and its tail hanging down his back, a cream scarf, a long cream robe with gold trim over a teal tunic with a teal sash and a gold buckle, a brown leather satchel stuffed with scrolls on a strap across the chest hanging at his screen-left hip, brown boots, and a wooden staff topped with a glowing gold star-shaped orb in his LEFT hand
hands: the gold-orb staff stays upright in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty fist resting on the satchel strap on the screen-left side

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (his empty right fist flung out to the left, the gold-orb staff thrown up and out in his left hand), the satchel and the turban tail jolting
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the gold-orb staff tilting back, his empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the gold-orb staff high, his empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, turbaned head droops, the gold-orb staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the staff slanting down with its gold orb resting on the ground at the lower-right, his empty right hand hanging by the satchel
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the gold-orb staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the cream robe flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the turban still on his head; the gold-orb staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the satchel lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the cream robe and the turban tail settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the gold-orb staff on the ground beside him
